{{Conjecture|legends}}
'''This being''' had four tentacles but nothing that an [[Arpor-Lan]] could identify as a head. It was four-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall and lived on a [[Unidentified planet (Deeve)|planet]] with a highly acidic [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].

At some point in the times of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Deeve]] climbed to the top of a cliff of this being's planet to perform a survey in search of useful natural resources. The being, noticing Deeve's presence, approached from behind a rock. Once Deeve identified the being's presence, and understanding he could not retreat without falling the cliff down, Deeve shot the soil near this being with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. The being stopped his approaching tentacle at the blast point. Unable to identify the being by himself, Deeve tried to analyze it with his technology and, through a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], asked the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Effcee]] for reinforcements.
